facts.fact: Dépêche.cd reports that National Assembly rapporteur Jacques Ndjoli presented his parliamentary bill on access to information and transparency of public life on 28 September 2026, and minister Patrick Muyaya said the government has made finalising the law a priority.
facts.system: Proposition de loi sur l'accès à l'information et la transparence de la vie publique

COD.note: The document says nothing on rural internet programmes or use.
No criticism of a named policy by a paper or group, and no cut or punishment, is stated.
